name: links
description: One list of every project's links: dev servers running on this desktop (through their tailscale serve front door), Cloud Run services and Firebase Hosting sites. The host finds them; a person pins the ones worth keeping, with an up/down check per pin. Off until switched on: cloud discovery runs gcloud with this desktop's own sign-in.
summary: Lists your projects' web addresses (dev servers, Cloud Run, Firebase) and checks whether each pinned one is up.
places: Home menu: the list of pinned and found links, with up or down for each pin
Session menu: the same list, from inside a session
Repo row: how many links this repo has; a tap lists only those
